text:
Maya: Quick FYI for the release train this week — planning a hard freeze Friday 2026-05-15 18:00 UTC for anything touching serving/runtime or model packaging.
Jon: Ack. Does the freeze include Dedicated infra config changes?
Maya: Yes — Dedicated autoscaling/pool changes included. If you need an exception, file it in #release-approvals before Thu EOD and ping me. :warning:
Sasha: Heads-up: embedding-model v2.3 is on the canary for the week. We'll start with 5% traffic next Tue and ramp based on latency regressions.
Liz: Any special steps for the quant plugin rollout? We have a few customers on pinned quantized builds.
Maya: Good question. Quant plugin changes are treated as high-risk. Required: (1) compatibility test matrix, (2) a canary rollback plan, (3) signed owner approval. See checklist: https://internal.redwood/rls/checklists/quant-safeguard (link)
Sasha: Pushed a brief canary runbook to the release docs. Command for starting canary is:
```
rtool rollout start --model embedding-v2.3 --canary 5 --watch
```
Liz: Are we gating mobile SDK version bumps during the freeze? Mobile SDK has transient infra calls.
Maya: Yes, minor SDK patches that don't touch model code are allowed but please coordinate and add the Release Note entry. If in doubt, request quick review.
Eng-SRE Oncall: We'll hold a surge window Friday 18:00-20:00 UTC in case rollbacks are needed. DeployBot will also enforce the freeze by rejecting merges to protected branches.
DeployBot: DeployGuard: Protected branch merges blocked for labels matching [runtime, model, quant] during freeze window.
Jon: Can owners DM me the list of endpoints that need sticky routing for canary? I want to pre-configure routing rules.
Sasha: Sending the list now. Also tagging @Maya for a post-mortem template if canary shows perf regressions.
Maya: Thanks — if anyone expects a deploy that must land during the freeze (hotfix/security), follow the freeze-exception doc and I'll triage. Otherwise assume the train is locked after Fri 18:00. :lock:
Liz: Understood. Will update the release board and the customer comms draft.
Maya: Final ask: owners confirm in-thread by EOD Thu so we have one consolidated list. :thumbsup:
